metadata.title: EAC Harmonized Compendium on Safety and Vigilance of Medical Products and Health Technologies (TMDA copy)
metadata.edition: Version 5.0, approved by the EAC Sectoral Council of Ministers of Health on 18 March 2019 · fatal 7, serious 15, non-serious local 30 calendar days; foreign cases in the PSUR/PBRER; no date of application in Tanzania stated
metadata.legal_basis: East African Community harmonised guideline posted by TMDA; national law prevails and the date from which Tanzania applies it is not stated.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.
